snippet.title: Call to Arms: Panzer Elite | Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
Call to Arms: Panzer Elite's biggest update yet is here!

The German Campaign is now fully complete with two new missions, alongside the arrival of the M18 Hellcat and M24 Chaffee. The update also adds Binoculars, reworked platoon commands with individual tank orders, visible machine gunners, expanded host settings, major AI improvements, and numerous gameplay enhancements.
